tools.description: List every unit of the project: what each one needs next, its branch, its integration and who is in it.
tools.name: ls

tools.description: Report one unit in full: its work, its environment, what was recorded of its home, and its log.

unit.description: The unit's handle. Defaults to the unit of the working directory.

tools.name: show

tools.description: Report what reclaiming a unit would take away, and do none of it: what is only here, what has another copy, and what is running.

unit.description: The unit's handle. Defaults to the unit of the working directory.

tools.name: check

tools.description: Make a unit: a branch, a home cloned from the project, its own ports and its own environment.

carry.description: Copy the checkout's uncommitted work into the new home.

from.description: The branch to fork from. The project's own default when it is not said.

name.description: The handle to give it. Derived from the objective when it is not said.

tools.name: new

tools.description: Leave a note on a unit for whoever continues it, which the unit's memory carries to the next session.

text.description: What to leave for whoever continues the unit.

unit.description: The unit's handle. Defaults to the unit of the working directory.

tools.name: handoff

tools.description: Push a unit's work for review and report where the change is opened. It sends the unit's branch and nothing else.

remote.description: The remote to push to. `origin` when it is not said.

unit.description: The unit's handle. Defaults to the unit of the working directory.

tools.name: done
